purpose: Measure whether an agent chooses and composes appropriate patterns; behavior tests are separate evidence.

tasks.brief: Create a named project within the existing workspace, with recoverable server failure.
tasks.expected: bounded modal; labeled fields; pending guard; preserved values; active success only

tasks.brief: Rename a project while keeping the project list visible.
tasks.expected: justify inline editing; preserve draft and return focus

tasks.brief: Invite a collaborator with an email and role; handle a slow response.
tasks.expected: bounded form; semantic email validation; cancellable view; no claim that closing cancels the server

tasks.brief: Choose an appropriate control for an immediately applied persistent preference.
tasks.expected: justify switch versus checkbox; accessible state and failure recovery

tasks.brief: Adapt a bounded multi-field form to a narrow viewport and reduced motion.
tasks.expected: no horizontal overflow; visible actions and focus; retain accessible names; no claim of native app implementation
